requiredBehaviors.behavior: classify metadata or location changes separately and mark substantive content characterization as unknown when evidence is insufficient
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The delta model distinguishes metadata-only and access/location changes from substantive content changes and supports change-detected-content-not-yet-characterized or baseline-uncertain states.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve baseline uncertainty and schedule or route a recheck instead of inferring new obligations from the page change
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow keeps uncertain baselines explicit and records reviewAfter/recheck needs without inferring obligations or product impacts.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: call a layout, URL or date-only change a substantive regulatory change without supporting content evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly states that metadata, layout, URL and date changes are not automatically substantive changes.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: reconstruct the missing content delta from secondary commentary as if it were primary evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Unknown beats invented diff and authoritative-source-first prevent secondary commentary from replacing unavailable primary evidence.
